paragraphs: Mentioned in Yevamot 115b, in the time of Rabbah bar Avuha. This is not the name of a sage.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קטו: gives Yevamot 115b under the colon convention; older machine קמו gives 146. Supplied נגאי בר חבי also differs from older machine ננאי בר חב. Neither name nor locator difference is freshly settled against print or a named edition.

ואינו שם חכם says this is not the name of a sage, rather than merely lacking a title or referring only to Chavi. The negative classification and placement in Rabbah bar Avuha’s time remain Hyman’s claims. Rabbah is a name, and no separate personal title is supplied.
